name: RAtouch
notes: No build needed: the published app contains no game data and the player imports their own Red Alert files in the app. Played on a physical iPad by its maintainer.

steps: Download the latest RAtouch unsigned IPA from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/ratouch/releases and check it against the SHA-256 file beside it.
Install it with AltStore Classic, SideStore or Sideloadly, signed with your own Apple ID.
Open RAtouch and import the Red Alert .MIX files (MAIN1.MIX, MAIN2.MIX and the others) from your own Steam copy of Command & Conquer Red Alert.
